# sendgrid_ip_pool (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid IP pool: a named group of dedicated IPs used to segment sending reputation. IPs must already be activated for sending on the account (via the SendGrid app) before they can be added to a pool.

~> The pool's `id` is its name; renaming the pool (changing `name`) updates the ID accordingly rather than replacing the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_ip_pool" "marketing" {
  name = "marketing"
  ips  = ["203.0.113.10", "203.0.113.11"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The pool's name.

### Optional

- `ips` (List of String) The IP addresses assigned to this pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The pool's name (identical to `name`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_ip_pool.marketing <pool_name>
```
